title: Beautiful personal size baking dishes but they chip easily
text:
Beautiful personal size baking dishes but they chip easily. These are beautiful rectangular personal-sized dishes. I got them to fit in my steamer and toaster oven and they work perfectly for that. However, they chip easily. In fact, mine arrived pre-chipped and it was packaged perfectly. I am very disappointed by that.

The current price of $23.74 ($24.99 minus 5% off) is expensive for this set, especially when they chip. Other than this, they are beautiful and giftable and perfect for one-person meals.
